title: Lazy task materialization on PostToolUse and git -uall expansion
what: PreInvocation only writes gitignored pending-prompt.json; tasks materialize in .harness/tasks on the first mutating PostToolUse. git working_tree_status uses -uall and current_branch falls back to symbolic-ref --short HEAD.
why: Prevents read-only questions from creating empty trash tasks, stops Git from collapsing new untracked folders into dir/, and avoids recording branch HEAD before the first commit.
learned: Also auto-enrich memory related_symbols from graph.bin when omitted so SymbolFreshnessProvider detects symbol staleness.
author: reactive-end
